title: Sa Ho

page_data.en:
Shanghai Municipal Police.
C. I. D.
L. O. REG
No. 598
Date 23. 9. 16
Hongkew Station.
September 23rd 1916
REPORT ON Stranded rebels in Shanghai ( Sin Wan Pao extract. )
Made by D.C.J.Reeves. Forwarded by
Sir,
Detectives who have been making enquiries into this matter
report that they have been unable to find any particulars of this
incident as reported in the Chinese Press. Enquiries have been
made at all tea shops on the Hanbury Road and in other parts of
the district and all without result.
I am Sir,
Your obedient servant.
Dcy. J. Reeves.
D.C.I.
" Chief Detective Inspector. "

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
刑事侦缉处。
L. O. REG
第 598 号
日期 16. 9. 23
虹口巡捕房。
1916年9月23日
关于滞留在上海的叛乱分子的报告（摘自《新闻报》）。
由 D.C.J. Reeves 撰写。呈送
阁下，
负责调查此事的侦探报告称，他们未能找到中文报刊所报道的这一事件的任何细节。已在汉璧礼路及本区其他地方的所有茶馆进行了查询，但均无结果。
此致，
您顺从的仆人。
Dcy. J. Reeves.
首席侦探督察。
“首席侦探督察。”

page_data.en:
Sin Wan Pao.
21-9-16.

The Stranded Rebels.
On the afternoon of the day before 3769
yesterday several tens of Koumingtang members Date 21.9.16
who were apparently of the poorer class,
assembled in a teashop on Hanbury Road.
They noticed two men passing by in a car
(? carriage). The rebels rushed out and
took the two men into the teashop stating
that owing to their long stay in Shanghai
they were in a state of distress and had
pawned their clothing to pass the autumn
festival that they heard the Government would
pay them repatriation money and they therefore
asked the two men to pay on behalf of the
Government. The two "prisoners" were obliged
to go to a cash shop and borrow several hundred
ten cent pieces with which they paid the crowd at
30 cents each. The assembly were satisfied with
the distribution and dispersed after releasing
the two "prisoners". Those who know the two
men told the reporter that one of them is named
Sa Ho 薩浩 and the other Li Yue Sung 李餘生
Both are prominent members of the Kuomingtang
party.

S. Hayter
For official report M.J

（左侧竖排文字，从右至左）
●流落黨人狼狽情形
前日午後有形極狼狽之黨人數十名在漢好路某茶
館集結見甲乙二人乘車經過若輩一擁上前將甲乙
攔入茶館聲稱吾等流寓上海安身已竭現屆秋節衣服
均付質庫聞政府己裝遣散費故邀集同志前來請願
云云甲乙見勢不佳向附近某小煙紙店借得小洋百數
十角每人發給三角始得脫身而去衆亦散歸有與甲乙
相識者謂甲姓薛名浩乙姓李名餘生均係民黨中重要
人物云
page_data.zh:
《新闻报》。
1916年9月21日。

滞留的叛乱分子。
前天下午，数十名国民党成员，日期 16.9.21
显然属于较贫困阶层，
聚集在汉璧礼路的一家茶馆里。
他们注意到有两人乘车
（？马车）经过。叛乱分子冲出去，
将这两人带入茶馆，声称由于他们在上海长期逗留，
处境困窘，并已典当衣物以度过中秋节，他们听说政府将
支付遣返费，因此要求这两人代表政府支付。两名“囚犯”被迫
去一家现兑店借了几百枚十仙硬币，以每人
30仙的价格分发给了人群。集会者对分配感到满意，在释放
两名“囚犯”后散去。认识这两人的人告诉记者，其中一人名为
Sa Ho 薩浩，另一人为 Li Yue Sung 李餘生。
两人均为国民党的重要成员。

S. Hayter
供正式报告 M.J
